mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.application_id, r.tenant_application_id, r.name, r.code, r.data_scope, r.available, r.sort, r.comment, r.version, r.is_delete, r.gmt_create, r.gmt_modify, r.create_user, r.modify_user FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.application_id = ur.application_id AND r.tenant_application_id = ur.tenant_application_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_delete = 0 AND r.available = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id DESC
